title: Assessment 2 — AI Brand Advert
source_document: MRU AICC Final Assessment Framework and Rubrics 2026.pdf

criteria.label: Creative concept and originality
criteria.official_description: A distinctive idea; avoids a generic or copied-feeling execution.

criteria.label: Brand/product communication
criteria.official_description: The brand/product is identifiable and its key appeal or message is clear.

criteria.label: Storytelling and structure
criteria.official_description: Coherent progression, suitable pacing, and a clear beginning/development/ending.

criteria.label: Visual quality and consistency
criteria.official_description: Intentional, appealing visuals; major continuity or generation errors do not distract.

criteria.label: Use and integration of AI
criteria.official_description: AI-generated elements are used purposefully and integrated into a coherent advert.

criteria.label: Audio, voice and music
criteria.official_description: Sound supports the advert; voice/dialogue and music are reasonably clear and balanced.

criteria.label: Editing and final delivery
criteria.official_description: Timing, cuts, titles and ending feel deliberate; video is complete and watchable.
